notes.title: Flat Eye Out Now!
notes.content:
Welcome to Flat Eye!

It’s finally time to open the doors to the station and let you take control and manage this futuristic crossroad for passing travellers.


You are the manager of the world’s premier gas and technological hub, where it’s your job to keep the station running smoothly, completing daily tasks while also monitoring your own and your customer’s mood. 

[previewyoutube=ok82a-aJhjo;full][/previewyoutube]

On top of that, you will encounter “premium customers” — clearly defined individuals with strong personalities, rich backstories and special needs. To ensure they keep coming back, listen and tailor to their needs, and build the modules they seem particularly interested in. 

It’s a tough job, but you don’t get paid minimum wage for nothing!

Flat Eye - We are all family here. 


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41653549/71dd3353ea06a443caec24be05bf417e0b1dd1a7.jpg

notes.title: Error 404 Header Not Found
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41653549/3a2e4d51e0e9a2571ae695cc02845c62edeb5b95.png

Dear Eye Life future employees, 

We have been tricked! Sabotaged from within! Employee [REDACTED], formerly a member of the Flat Eye systems and maintenance division, was foolish enough to use our MemoryService Module without proper supervision. This has resulted in crucial time being lost for the finalized development of Flat Eye. With the ContinuityUnwinder still in development, we can not rely on time travel to solve the issue. 

This means that our grand opening on October 17th has been postponed by a little over 4 weeks as we catch up on the polish and finetuning [REDACTED] forgot. We could not allow the Flat Eye system accidentally causing harm to our customers (employees come secondary). 

We expect you to gain access to your station on November 14th. We will keep the Flat Eye demo simulation up and running until the doors fly open, as small compensation. Please stay tuned, and we appreciate your patience. 

- Eye Life Upper Management

notes.title: FLAT EYE DEMO REVIEW | GamesRadar+
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41653549/37423b1770a2a631536f9ef191a3fdaaee4e582b.jpg

We're delighted to share that we've been included in GamesRadar's '14 Steam Next Fest demos to play before the week is out' list!

In their review, they write...

'I love it when a management sim has a really strong storyline – in fact I think it doesn't happen enough. But, that's exactly what we're getting from Flateye. You don't get tonnes of story in the demo, but there's a load of hints as to what the larger narrative at play is. You're essentially managing a gas station, but one from way, way in the future – where toilets can harvest personal data and plugging waste from those same toilets into food machines that need bio-matter to function. Is this… recycling? It's certainly not your average management sim, and I can't wait to see more from this one.'

'Playing the Flat Eye demo just makes me want to run a futuristic Icelandic gas station'

We're incredibly grateful for all of your positive feedback on the game and will continue to listen to any and all feedback on our Twitter or in our Steam discussions.

notes.title: Welcome to the Flat Eye Demo
notes.content:
Welcome to Flat Eye!

The time has finally come. We are participating in Steam Next Fest, which means we have a demo available from October 3rd to 10th for you to try. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41653549/71dd3353ea06a443caec24be05bf417e0b1dd1a7.jpg

In this demo, you will be able to manage your station by building futuristic modules, interacting with customers, and managing their moods as well as yours. On top of that, you will meet two of your Premium customers, engaging in dialogue and figuring out their unique needs. 

This demo is a limited version of the full game, so please note that there will be more to experience once we launch on November 14th. This means more Premium customers, modules, and things to do. 

We hope you will enjoy managing the world’s premier gas and technological hub. 

Flat Eye - We're watching.

notes.title: Flat Eye Modules | ToiletSmart
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41653549/5a7f5f9c715886be244cd76a6654de4b5ae69440.png

Introducing ToiletSmart!

It’s just a simple truth of nature that toilets are a must at any station, whether in the past, present or future. While the simple toilets are effectively remnants of the old world, with time, patience, and collecting the right amount of resources, you can upgrade them to the ToiletSmart. 


As far as technology goes, ToiletSmart are as quiet as they are intricate. In fact, Customers use them with no knowledge of the sophisticated amount of data and matter stored by EyeLife. In a flush, the company find out about the health, the habits, and the future of the Customer. 

Flat Eye - Number 1 for your Number 2.

notes.title: Flat Eye Characters | Meet Javier
notes.content:
INFORMATION FROM FLAT EYE DATABASE

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41653549/e3f2dc65d16d6cb72a2f9e97abd9f7aa7d3ade6d.png

Name: Javier
Age: 22
Pronouns: He/They
Country of Origin: Spain / European
Income Group: Middle Class
Astrological Sign: Scarab (formerly known as Cancer) 
Statement of Note: The world is on the brink of collapse… and I’m a pusher. 

Javier is what you would call an political warrior, a fighter for nature. In their eyes, actions speak more than words can, and Javier shows their genuine convictions by walking the walk.

While born in Spain, they moved around a lot during their youth, quickly gaining a drive to go far and hard to save the Earth. This, in turn, is what led them to the shores of Iceland, fighting against the North Atlantic whaling industry. Javier is not a fan of Flat Eye, but will enter the station when more controversial modules are installed.

notes.title: Flat Eye Modules | HeartfeltGifts
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41653549/33e7bdeaa642e4ccaeabcb731cf1dfad1f1f10bf.png

Introducing HeartfeltGifts!


A practical module that has survived the test of time and technological advancements, the VendingMachine offers Customers whatever items are stocked at the press of a button. However, with the appropriate upgrades, you can take this simple module and bring it to the future. 

Introducing - the HeartfeltGifts. This upgraded version does require additional modules to help support it, but once it’s up and running Customers can fulfill all their organ needs. Do you need a heart or a lung? We got you covered. 

Flat Eye - our hearts are ripe for the harvest!

notes.title: Flat Eye Characters | Meet Hal
notes.content:
INFORMATION FROM FLAT EYE DATABASE

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41653549/a7309719d81a9a2792a51d8ab286dfdac778b104.png

Name: Hal
Age: 21
Pronouns: They/Them
Country of Origin: Iceland
Income Group: Middle Class
Astrological Sign: Pisces
Statement of Note: Imagine if you were 300 years old now.

A constant source of positivity and empathy, as well as the occasional wave of anxiety, Hal is a 21-year-old Icelander still living with their parents. While they are currently working in a music store, their true passion lies in fashion and travel. 

Due to circumstances outside of their control, the possibility of Hal leaving Iceland has been limited, but they hope they can soon explore the world fully. While Hal is interested in many of Flat Eye’s modules, they are especially drawn to those that improve overall health.

notes.title: Flat Eye Modules | DoctorBooth
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41653549/667b7df0e6a933e52f4d2e47c842c50244850b0d.png

Introducing the DoctorBooth!

Have a weird pain that just won’t go away? Been coughing up blood? We have the solution for you, with our DoctorBooth. By stepping into it, the booth will analyze and check your entire body before diagnosing your illness and in some cases, provide you with a cure through one of our other modules. Why bother making an appointment when you can find all the medical answers you require through a simple scan and the press of a button? 

Flat Eye - One DoctorBooth a day keeps the doctor away

notes.title: Flat Eye Modules | FarEast
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41653549/3320e6eb03ea0ed2c0c179eec71847839712ab67.png

Introducing the FarEast!


Who hasn’t wanted to teleport from one point on Earth to another at the blink of an eye? Thanks to the amazing technological advancements made by EyeLife, that possibility is now here. Simply step into the FarEasy and see yourself whisked away to the other side of the planet. Thanks to our added security detectors and sanitizing stations, we will ensure that your journey is as smooth and clean as possible. You don’t need to know how we do it; instead, focus on eliminating any travel time moving forward. 

Flat Eye - making even the impossible possible.

notes.title: Flat Eye Characters | Meet Lukas
notes.content:
INFORMATION FROM FLAT EYE DATABASE


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41653549/9d4fc075eacd45521241193c9e9a461af211c73e.png

Name: Lukas
Age: 34
Pronouns: He/They
Country of Origin: Iceland
Income Group: Middle Class
Astrological Sign: Scarab (formerly known as Cancer)
Statement of Note: Can I clone someone without… without their permission?

Born and raised in Iceland, Lukas is a game developer for a big studio in Reykjavik. As of last year, he is married to Jim, a Canadian man he fell in love with while they were working together. 

Often seen wearing dirty clothes and sporting unkempt hair, Lukas is not a very tidy person.  Due to his shy and disorganized nature, Lukas struggles to communicate with those around him, including his loved ones. By visiting the Flat Eye station, he hopes to find a module that will help him open up to those in his life that matter most.

notes.title: Flat Eye Modules | CashSmart
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41653549/1551460f35234ee58d29f6d0c1aabd7de32004c3.png
Introducing the CashSmart!


The center point for the entire Flat Eye station when you are just starting off, the CashRegister does exactly what you would expect - it scans simple items for purchase. Except it breaks… a lot. And Customers generally don’t like that.

Once you’ve accumulated enough money, you can even replace it with its more reliable upgraded version - the CashSmart, which works by itself, utilizes a simple-to-understand touch screen, and puts the power of the purchase into the Customers hands. 

Flat Eye - making even the smallest interactions as smooth as possible.

notes.title: Flat Eye | WELCOME TO YOUR GAS STATION!
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41653549/ab8a1ec01782b9eb4edba0f25a6ff96ca89c627f.png
Welcome to the gas station of the future!


Not only is Flat Eye the crossroad for passing travellers, but it’s also a technological hub that evolves with every new module installed. By balancing the happiness of your Customers with items and services sold, you can customize your station to provide all kinds of solutions for those passing through. 

Your Flat Eye station can have everything from organ vending machines to one-way teleporters - the choice is yours. And keep a look out for our Premium Customers. More than a dozen distinct individuals will enter your station and are clearly here for their own reasons. By providing services tailored to their unique needs, you can develop technology to alter the future of humanity. 


Flat Eye, making decisions for the benefit of everyone.

notes.title: Flat Eye | Opening in 2022
notes.content:
Welcome to the Flat Eye™ Team!


We’re looking forward to welcoming you to your very own Flat Eye™ gas station this year.

As the manager of a single Flat Eye™ location, you will optimize your products and services based on the Flat Eye™ intuitive shopping algorithms. Upgrade your store to better serve your loyal customers and unlock narrative paths along the way. 

[previewyoutube=Lh3qqeoPsv0;full][/previewyoutube]

Flat Eye is a management sim with an emphasis on the stories told through returning customers. These stories touch on humanity’s increasing reliance on technological advances and digital privacy, spanning from the absurd and comical to the eye-opening and unnerving.

notes.title: You. Us. You Again.
notes.content:
The EyeLife corporation is pleased to announce the first of many new and exciting technologies designed to enhance your life and business.

[previewyoutube=WTlK_6DvXwI;full][/previewyoutube]
The EyeLife corporation understands that in these hectic times, you all need a little help. That’s why our proprietary cloning booths are headed to every Flat Eye gas station.
